Fuzzes type decode and encode round trips with structured input generation.

# Purpose
This file implements a libFuzzer target for `fd_types_vt` binary encoding and decoding. It initializes the `fd` runtime, attaches a large scratch allocator, and then uses type metadata from `fd_types_vt_list` to decode fuzz input, encode the decoded value again, decode it a second time, and compare the results. The checks verify that encode and decode are consistent, that the encoded size does not grow after a decode-encode cycle, and that the encoded bytes remain stable across normalization.

The file also defines a custom mutator for structured fuzzing. It can either mutate existing input with `LLVMFuzzerMutate` or generate a new value by finding a `*_generate` function with `dlsym`, then encoding that value into fuzz input. Several types are excluded through `blacklist`, and special cases are handled for `fd_pubkey` and some `fd_vote_instruction` discriminant values. The file is therefore a fuzzing harness and input generator for public type serialization interfaces, not a general application or library entry point.
